BiblicalUsage: Whiteness is what libnah means — a clearness like sapphire under God's feet, not Libnah the city, which shares its name. In Exodus 24:10, "and as it were the body of heaven in [his] clearness.".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the whiteness under God's feet is the closest Moses came to describing Him — a paved work of sapphire, clear as the body of heaven.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
